title: Line graphs
summary: Identify timelines, units, turning points and grouped trends. Build an introduction, overview and comparative body paragraphs.

title: Bar charts
summary: Distinguish static and changing categories, select key comparisons and structure a clear overview with grouped details.

title: Pie charts
summary: Compare proportions and changes, identify dominant sectors and use percentage, fraction and comparison language accurately.

title: Tables
summary: Select important rows, columns and contrasts rather than listing every value. Plan the overview and group numerical evidence.

title: Mixed charts
summary: Connect the main features across different charts, compare related measures and organize a coherent four-paragraph response.

title: Process diagrams
summary: Map stages and sequence, distinguish natural and manufactured processes, and choose appropriate voice and linking language.

title: Opinion / agree-disagree essays
summary: Choose a clear stance, sustain it through the essay and develop relevant reasons, examples and a consistent conclusion.

title: Maps and plans
summary: Describe spatial changes and unchanged features, group locations logically and use accurate direction, tense and passive structures.

title: Discussion + opinion essays
summary: Represent both views fairly, develop supporting arguments and state your own opinion consistently throughout the response.

title: Problem / cause and solution essays
summary: Analyze the exact cause/problem and solution instructions. Develop linked explanations, feasible remedies and PEEL body paragraphs.

title: Two-part questions
summary: Answer both questions directly, give each a focused body paragraph and bring both responses together in the conclusion.

title: Positive / negative development essays
summary: Evaluate the development, choose a defensible position and support a clear overall judgement with explained arguments and examples.

title: Advantages and disadvantages
summary: Build a balanced evaluation, support both sides and write a clear judgement.
